author: David Bombal
description:
Register for IBM Z Day 2026: https://ibm.biz/ibmzday-db (it’s FREE)

AI is transforming enterprise technology, but it also brings new cybersecurity challenges. How can organizations protect sensitive data, secure autonomous AI systems, and prepare for emerging threats?

 Join IBM Z Day 2026: AI at the Core on November 18 for a FREE global virtual event featuring 300+ technology experts and 7 technical tracks exploring the future of AI, cybersecurity, and enterprise computing.

 What can you expect?
· Agentic AI & AI Security: Explore the opportunities and security risks of autonomous AI systems.
· Trustworthy AI: Learn about AI governance, transparency, and enterprise-scale deployment.
·Cybersecurity & Quantum Readiness: Discover approaches to protecting mission-critical infrastructure against evolving threats.
· AI & Data: Explore real-time AI-powered decisions, enterprise data innovation, and intelligent automation.
· 6 IBM Digital Badges: Opportunities to earn credentials across AI
title: Free AI Security Training? Here’s How
